forces: The verification suite must fail only for reasons about the code or gates under test, never because of a git housekeeping race.
No git command run in a disposable repository may start a background writer inside it.
An ambient git configuration must not be able to re-enable that writer.
A failed removal must stay loud, never be retried away.

applicability.full_trigger_absence_proof: No full assessment trigger applies. The change is one bounded correction to an unshipped verification-test fixture and introduces no abstraction, module, class, interface, or public API, so public_api is not matched. It only adds two git configuration flags to the commands the helper runs in temporary repositories, so it changes no integration, lifecycle_or_state, concurrency, persistence, or security_sensitive_behavior. It touches no governance_core_path. The SDK's source, its public API, its packed contents, and every test's assertions are unchanged, and no requirement text or canonical capability requirement changes.

security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, contract, integrity assertion, or checksum changes; the correction only configures disposable Git repositories used by the verification suite.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization mechanism changes; the helper commands make no principal, permission, or access-control decision.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority source, signature, provenance field, owner decision, or release authorization changes; the two flags exist only for one disposable repository lifetime.
security_justification.concurrency: The correction prevents a detached Git writer in temporary repositories but adds no scheduler, lock, shared state, or concurrent coordination behavior.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secret, credential, or confidential payload handling changes; the configuration values concern only disposable local Git state.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, digest calculation, key handling, signing, or verification behavior changes; the SDK's packed contents remain unchanged.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No diagnostic surface changes; a failed removal remains loud without exposing repository contents, credentials, or additional data.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security product, network service, exporter, collector deployment, or third-party security integration is introduced or changed.
security_justification.fail_posture: The change prevents the known background writer before it starts and retains the existing loud failure for any other removal problem.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK, sink, operation, package, or release lifecycle transition changes; the flags apply only to commands run in the suite's temporary repositories.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: The change writes no persistent configuration; it passes two command-line flags, and the live repository remains read-only with removal explicit.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy transformation, data classification, redaction, prohibited-data scan, or personal-data processing behavior changes.
security_justification.resource_retention: No storage or retention policy changes; the affected Git state is contained in temporary repositories the existing remover deletes.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, queueing, or attempt behavior changes; removal retries are expressly rejected by this correction.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The existing repository and local temporary-directory boundaries remain unchanged; no principal, external system, or trust crossing is added.
